implementation.status: Anton (display) and Inter (UI, body, and transactional text) are the intended families; self-host both with their SIL OFL license files in the FULL VOLUME app. The stacks above are fallbacks.
implementation.loading: Declare self-hosted files with @font-face and font-display: swap. No runtime Google Fonts requests. If the generated wordmark lettering fails, set FULL VOLUME in Anton in code.
implementation.wrapping: Anton is restricted to short campaign phrases: H1 and H2, the CTA band headline, and the expanding campaign wordmark. Navigation, tables, ticket options, prices, forms, and policies always use Inter. Never force desktop line breaks on mobile.
implementation.metrics: Use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for set times, set lengths, prices, quantities, and totals so columns align. Check Anton fallback width and layout shift after the font loads; condensed fallbacks run wider.
implementation.responsive: Use clamp for display roles, keep body text at 1rem or larger and captions at 14px or larger, and verify 320px reflow and 200% text zoom with the longest act names and placeholders.
